newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan Oct output seen up 3.5 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan Oct output seen up 3.5 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Japan's industrial production is likely to have risen 3.5 percent in October month-on-month, according to a Reuters poll of economic research institutions.

Their forecasts, which on average predicted a rise of 3.5 percent, ranged from growth of 2.7 percent to growth of 4.1 percent. In September, industrial output rose a revised 1.5 percent from August. Preliminary data for October will be released at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) on Thursday.
Economists said production in the automobile and electronic industries continues to increase, and inventory adjustment is near completion.
But the expected rise in October is also due to the fact there are more business days in that month than in others, an economist at Salomon Brothers said.
